items.name: blocks
items.title: Block clients
items.description: lib/blocks.ts: the blocks as typed clients over the Data API, acting as the caller, plus the notification types.
items.docs: Needs the blocks it wires: `npx better-supabase add organizations notifications search audit`, then `npx better-supabase gen` for `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts`. Add a block to `blockSet` after you install it. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/create-blocks.

items.name: postgres
items.title: Server Postgres pool
items.description: lib/postgres.ts: one Postgres pool for the server-side blocks (outbox, jobs, webhook inbox, billing).
items.docs: The pool reads `SUPABASE_DB_URL`, then `DATABASE_URL`; the value above is the local stack from `supabase start`. Never import it from client code. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue.

items.name: notifications-actions-next
items.title: Notification server actions (Next.js)
items.description: Server actions that list, count and mark the caller's notifications, for useNotifications on the web.
items.docs: Needs the notifications block (`npx better-supabase add notifications`) and the `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` that `npx better-supabase init` writes for Next.js. See https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/notification-bell.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: lib/onboarding.ts: a getting-started checklist definition to edit, shared by the config and useOnboarding.
items.docs: Needs the onboarding block: `npx better-supabase add onboarding`, with the checklist in its `checklists` option. See https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/onboarding-checklist.

items.name: outbox
items.title: Outbox client
items.description: lib/outbox.ts: the outbox on the server connection, which the relay routes use.
items.docs: Needs the outbox block: `npx better-supabase add outbox`. `APP_URL` becomes each CloudEvent's `source`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox.

items.name: outbox-relay-next
items.title: Outbox relay route (Next.js)
items.description: app/api/outbox/route.ts: a cron route that relays each registered consumer's events.
items.docs: Needs the outbox block: `npx better-supabase add outbox`. Schedule it with `{ "crons": [{ "path": "/api/outbox", "schedule": "* * * * *" }] }` in `vercel.json`, and set a random `CRON_SECRET` in production. With a `src/` folder, move the file to `src/app/api/outbox/route.ts`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox.

items.name: outbox-relay-hono
items.title: Outbox relay route (Hono)
items.description: routes/outbox.ts: a Hono route that relays each registered consumer's events.
items.docs: Needs the outbox block: `npx better-supabase add outbox`. Mount it with `app.route("/outbox", outboxRoutes)` and call it from a cron that sends `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox.

items.name: stripe-webhook-next
items.title: Stripe webhook routes (Next.js)
items.description: A Stripe webhook route that stores verified events, and a cron route that hands them to the billing block.
items.docs: Needs the billing block and the webhook inbox: `npx better-supabase add billing webhook-inbox`. Point a Stripe test-mode webhook (or `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe`) at the first route, and schedule `/api/stripe/process`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/billing.

items.name: jobs-drain-next
items.title: Jobs drain cron route (Next.js)
items.description: lib/jobs.ts and app/api/jobs/drain/route.ts: the queues and the cron route that runs schedules and drains them.
items.docs: Needs the jobs block with the drain scheduler: `npx better-supabase add jobs`, with `scheduler: "drain"` in its options. Schedule it with `{ "crons": [{ "path": "/api/jobs/drain", "schedule": "* * * * *" }] }` in `vercel.json`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue#drain-route.

items.name: ai-chat-next
items.title: AI chat routes (Next.js)
items.description: lib/assistant.ts and the app/api/chat routes: the ai-chat block's assistant, the tools it may call, and the routes that send a message, resume its stream and stop it.
items.docs: Needs the ai-chat and streams blocks (`npx better-supabase add ai-chat`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and an AI Gateway key. Add the blocks' tools in `assistantTools`. Pair it with the `use-ai-chat` hooks on the client. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/ai-sdk/chat.

items.docs: Needs the organizations block (`npx better-supabase add organizations`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/organizations#switching-organizations.

The Rule builder recipe renders it. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/automations#editor.

items.name: push-native
items.title: usePushRegistration (Expo)
items.description: Registers the device's Expo push token for the signed-in user with the push block.
items.docs: Needs the push block (`npx better-supabase add push`) and the `src/lib/supabase/client.native.ts` that `npx better-supabase init` writes for Expo. Push tokens need the EAS project id outside Expo Go. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/push.

items.name: expo-config-native
items.title: Expo config
items.description: app.config.ts: the URL scheme for auth deep links, secure session storage and push, on top of app.json.
items.docs: Set `scheme` in `app.json` to your app's scheme; magic links and OAuth redirect to it, and `handleAuthDeepLink` from `better-supabase/client/native` finishes the sign-in. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/frameworks/expo.

items.name: saas-next
items.title: SaaS glue (Next.js)
items.description: The glue for the saas preset on Next.js: block clients, notification actions, onboarding, the organization hook and the outbox, jobs and Stripe routes.
items.docs: Install the blocks first: `npx better-supabase add organizations invitations notifications search audit onboarding outbox jobs billing webhook-inbox`. The UI comes from the recipes at https://bettersupabase.com/recipes.

items.docs: Install the blocks first: `npx better-supabase add organizations invitations notifications search audit onboarding push`. The UI comes from the recipes at https://bettersupabase.com/recipes.
